$schema: BC.W-FOLD-LEDGER — the machine-checkable no-silent-drop source-of-truth. One row per distinct fold (213); the human face is docs/tranches/BC/DEFERRAL-LEDGER.md (F1 keeps them in sync). disposition ∈ {BUILD,RETIRE,MET,HELD-with-rationale,SUPERSEDED} — DECIDED, never re-booked. A BUILD/MET row's `band` is DERIVED from the named `wave`'s on-disk **Band:** header (F1.b), NEVER transcribed from the doc (Band N) parenthetical. proof:bc-fold-ledger REDs the close on any dropped/undecided/phantom-dest/band-only-dest row.

closeUnion.note: The masked-accretion cure (BB.W-CLOSE-BATTERY applied PER-ROUND): the close runs `--run full` siblings-absent at EVERY round close, not only the terminal cut. A `--run local`-only close (ci ⊂ local) is forbidden — it is the close-class lie that let 18 ci-tagged reds ride along in BB.
